name: River Levee Levees and Dike
title: River Levee Levees and Dike
description: River Levee Levees and Dike is a complete levees and dike blueprint record in this database, covering the full plan set from site layout to final details. The design calls for 15 ft high levee with 12 ft crown and 3:1 slopes, built from Compacted earth fill in lifts. Freeboard 3 ft above design flood. No trees on the levee prism. The plan sheets include cross-section sheets, crown and ramp plans, and seepage control details. Taught at ladder rank 1 of 20 (Foundations): core concepts, parts, and safe building practices. Signature-line original design by the JAH system; verify against local codes before building.
dimensions: 15 ft high levee with 12 ft crown and 3:1 slopes
structural_notes: Freeboard 3 ft above design flood. No trees on the levee prism.
